title: Reopen closed tab restores an empty SideChat tab
impact: Reopening a closed SideChat restores its outer tab but not its released conversation record, leaving an empty body instead of the previous work.
recommendation: Define close and reopen policy with the resource lifecycle. Restore the same durable conversation, or exclude intentionally destroyed SideChats from reopen with clear lifecycle copy. Do not silently create a new fork. File previews are a distinct case because panel/preview.rs:298-319 hydrates them.
acceptance: Create a side conversation containing a unique marker through the UI, close its tab, and invoke Reopen closed tab. The same identity and marker return with working controls, or a deliberately unsupported action is unavailable and explained. Repeat during fork startup and failed restoration; no duplicate provider work or blank body is allowed.
